title: One public source, several delivery surfaces
when: Following a source link, updating guidance or diagnosing drift
need: Product help is authored under docs/public and delivered to the website and installed .yoke/docs. Project rules/docs and installed Pack files have separate ownership.
surface: Public source → website / install bundle; project-owned documents remain local
gap: A public and installed copy are distribution, not two authorities. Private Yoke/Platform operations should link to public customer guidance; exact build versions can differ.
